status: Selected brand reference; integrated and visually reviewed in the local desktop build. No public release or all-OS installation claim.
locale_rule: Use the same base-language normalization as productName(lang); ko and ko-* use Korean, every other language uses the English/default artwork.
colour_rule: Keep the original B symbol colours in light/dark/system themes. Swap only wordmark foreground for dark. Never invert the whole coloured SVG.
mono_role: Supplemental use when one ink is required; not the automatic default for dark mode.

AI_mark.a11y: Decorative SVG; keep the existing translated visible button label or accessible name.
AI_mark.className: Preserve optional className, including ai-mark on the slides 14px button.

native_default_lockup: English light outlined artwork for generated presentation exports. The desktop Home uses the optical-small symbol and live Pretendard text instead of these outlined lockups.
native_preview_warning: The current Onyou generator uses separate light/dark colour assets without inversion. Earlier asset-only validation used an isolated copy of the old generator.

desktop_integration.wordmark: live productName(lang) text, local Pretendard Variable 600, 14px
desktop_integration.theme: semantic text foreground; original blue symbol colours
desktop_integration.release_scope: local Mac arm64 verification; no publication
